facts.text: I am writing an inspirational and evangelical sales pitch for a feature store company.
I want to open the sales pitch with something big, inspirational, and ambitious.
I believe the main thing that affects how well ML applications perform is how well they understand the world.
I believe that understanding is based on the data the ML applications receive about users and products, called features.
I believe the world’s best ML teams invest heavily in feature infrastructure.
I want to build a platform for a team to do the best featuring engineering.
I want the pitch to claim 10x faster iteration.
I want the pitch to claim 10x cheaper.

keyphrases: features data about users and products
